columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: HITL resume must restore the capabilities required by the resumed responsibility
columns.title_zh: HITL 恢复必须恢复继续履责所需的能力
columns.source_zh: Google ADK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260813-G-007 with Skill 02 score 46/50. It isolates a bounded Digital Employee question: after a human-in-the-loop pause, which execution capabilities must be reconstructed so the resumed agent can still hand work to the intended agent? The maintainer change is implementation-level and directly testable at the pause/resume responsibility boundary. It outranks the other Digital Employee candidate because it adds a distinct recovery-capability problem rather than another admission-routing variant.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260813-G-007，Skill 02 评分 46/50。它形成一个有界的数字员工问题：经过 Human-in-the-Loop 暂停后，恢复运行时必须重建哪些执行能力，才能让 Agent 继续把工作移交给目标 Agent？该维护者变更属于实现层，可直接验证暂停/恢复的职责边界。与另一数字员工候选相比，它提供了独立的恢复能力问题，而不是再次研究输入接纳路由。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify when transfer_to_agent disappears across HITL pause/resume, where it is restored, the exact resumed-flow condition that requires it, the failure mode before the fix, and the boundary between restoring a declared capability and granting new authority. Do not generalize beyond the evidenced ADK resume path.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 transfer_to_agent 在 HITL 暂停/恢复边界何时丢失、在哪里恢复、哪些恢复流程条件要求该能力、修复前的具体失败模式，以及“恢复已声明能力”和“授予新权限”之间的边界；不得超出有证据的 ADK Resume 路径泛化。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Generation-aware recovery prevents stale session control after runtime host replacement
columns.title_zh: 具备 Generation 语义的恢复可阻止运行时 Host 替换后的过期会话控制
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260813-G-003 with Skill 02 score 45/50. It exposes a bounded runtime-architecture problem: a logical session can survive host replacement only if reconnection is serialized, identities are scoped to the new host generation, shutdown is coordinated, and stale control requests are rejected. The competing memory/cache signal is also strong, but this object presents a clearer multi-step recovery protocol with explicit stale-state rejection and concurrency behavior.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260813-G-003，Skill 02 评分 45/50。它暴露了一个有界的运行时架构问题：逻辑 Session 要在 Host 替换后继续存在，必须同时处理重连串行化、将身份绑定到新的 Host Generation、协调关闭，并拒绝过期控制请求。另一个 Memory/Cache Signal 同样较强，但本对象给出了更清晰的多步骤恢复协议，并显式包含 Stale State 拒绝与并发行为。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify host-generation identity, cached-session reopen behavior, concurrent reconnection serialization, cell-ID scoping, shutdown coordination, stale wait/terminate rejection, and the tests defining those guarantees. Separate demonstrated code-mode behavior from broader distributed-session implications.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 Host Generation Identity、缓存 Session 的重新打开、并发重连串行化、Cell ID 作用域、关闭协调、过期 wait/terminate 请求拒绝，以及定义这些保证的测试；必须把已证明的 Code Mode 行为与更广泛的分布式 Session 含义分开。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Dynamic MCP credentials need a constrained helper boundary, not arbitrary header injection
columns.title_zh: 动态 MCP 凭据需要受约束的 Helper 边界，而不是任意 Header 注入
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260813-G-004 with Skill 02 score 45/50. It is the strongest bounded Open-source Engineering object in the run-date pool: a useful dynamic-header feature is surrounded by origin isolation, redirect blocking, reserved/duplicate-header rejection, command and output bounds, managed validation and redaction. This creates a concrete, regression-testable design question about adding dynamic credentials without turning a helper process into an unrestricted request-mutation surface.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260813-G-004，Skill 02 评分 45/50。它是运行日信号池中最强的有界开源工程对象：动态 Header 能力同时受到 Origin 隔离、禁止重定向、保留/重复 Header 拒绝、命令与输出边界、Managed 校验以及脱敏保护。由此形成一个具体、可回归测试的设计问题：如何增加动态凭据能力，同时避免 Helper Process 变成不受约束的请求修改面。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify helper invocation scope, origin binding, redirect policy, header validation and duplicate/reserved-name rejection, process/output limits, secret redaction, failure handling, and tests. Do not infer general credential security beyond this local streamable-HTTP MCP path.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 Helper 调用作用域、Origin 绑定、重定向策略、Header 校验与重复/保留名称拒绝、进程与输出上限、Secret 脱敏、失败处理以及测试；不得把结论泛化为该本地 Streamable-HTTP MCP 路径之外的一般凭据安全证明。
